# Pingtally

> Pingtally (also known in Hebrew as "קופה משפחתית") helps households manage
> expenses, receipts, shopping lists and budgets from inside WhatsApp - no
> password, no app to install, and no bank connection. Hebrew, RTL. For one
> person, a couple, a family, or a flatshare.

Pingtally does NOT connect to your bank or read credit-card transactions. You
choose what to send (an expense, a receipt, a shopping item, or a budget). AI
helps read receipts and categorize expenses but does not give financial advice.
Login is via a one-time WhatsApp magic link valid for 15 minutes; the dashboard
opens only after a verified login. Personal expenses stay personal; children can
add items without seeing the household budget. Information is not sold.

Pricing (incl. VAT, one price per account, 20-day free trial, no card to start,
cancel anytime): Personal/Couple (up to 2 users) 19.90/mo or 199/yr; Family
(up to 4) 29.90/mo or 299/yr; Family 4+ (5 or more) 39.90/mo or 399/yr.
